regime_context: As of 2026-08-07, the S&P/TSX thematic landscape shows Base Metals & Copper (XBM.TO) as the dominant narrative with strong breadth and moderate durability, while Gold Miners (XGD.TO) present a healthy challenger trend. theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals hold the highest theme momentum rank with full breadth and no crowding flag, giving them trend-following leadership. The absolute-trend gate is helpful, but the mixed Hurst tag and the backtest warning that momentum rank is only an attention lens limit conviction. Position only within drawdown-control sizing.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO lags the S&P/TSX Composite by more than 2% cumulative over the next 30 days

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners rank #2 with trend-like Hurst, high durability (0.79) and full breadth, making them a solid challenger in a broad rotation. The absolute-trend gate supports the theme’s staying power, though it has not yet confirmed leadership handoff from Base Metals.
theses.dissent: Crowding-skeptic: current macro narrative is dominated by AI/tech and geopolitics, which could pivot sentiment away from safe havens abruptly; gold’s trend health may reflect a crowded safe-haven trade that has already discounted bad news.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO underperforms XBM.TO by more than 3% over the next 30 days, or its durability_bar drops below 0.5

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
